messages.text: Can you build me a full-body strength routine, no equipment, for twice a week?

paragraphs: Look, when you're training purely with bodyweight, consistency and clean reps beat everything. I put together a full-body routine built around solid fundamentals: squats, lunges, push-ups, upper back engagement, and core control. Run this twice a week with at least 48 hours in between so your legs stay fresh for cycling and football. Check it out and let's get after it.

messages.text: Two things - I want to permanently swap the core phase out of the full-body strength routine you just built me, going forward, my lower back doesn't handle it well, every time, not just today. And separately, can you restructure this week specifically - add a 20 minute mobility session on Saturday, just for this week.

paragraphs:
Look, if your lower back does not agree with the core work, forcing it makes zero sense. Listening to that pattern protects the rest of your training. I took the core phase out of that full-body routine permanently. For this week, I added that 20-minute mobility session onto today's schedule for Saturday. Focus on moving easy and letting the back decompress.
